projectInfo.name: Unity VR Light Tunnel Project
projectInfo.primaryUse: VR room with light tunnel effects

lightTunnel.description: Tunnel with half-sphere lights and cylinders for neon tube lighting
lightTunnel.orientation: Strips arranged front-to-back, lights within strips arranged left-to-right

spatialLayout.example: Light 6 = left side near top, Light 16 = right side third from bottom

neonTubes.spatialLayout: Left to right (MRAN_1 = bottom left, MRAN_17 = bottom right)

properties._UnlitColor: Color for unlit mode if used
properties._UseEmissiveIntensity: Flag to enable intensity control (set to 1)

keywords._EMISSION: Must be enabled for emission to work

importantAttributes.ExecuteAlways: REQUIRED for Edit mode functionality - script will not run in Edit mode without this
importantAttributes.CustomEditor: Used for custom inspector buttons (Preview, Stop, Reset)

editModeRequirements.cleanup: Must unsubscribe from EditorApplication.update in OnDestroy/OnDisable

development.workingStyle: One focused task per context window to avoid file confusion

testing.reason: Faster iteration without entering Play mode

agents.purpose: Catch compilation errors, duplicate methods, Unity anti-patterns before commit

StripLightController.cs.purpose: Sequential strip lighting controller with Edit mode preview
features: HDR color control with separate emission intensity
Memory leak prevention (material cleanup in OnDestroy)
requirements: Must be attached to VR_Room GameObject

features: Status indicator when preview is running

criticalMistakes.impact: Script wouldn't run in Edit mode at all
criticalMistakes.solution: Always add [ExecuteAlways] for Edit mode scripts

criticalMistakes.issue: Used Standard shader properties (_Color, _EmissionColor) instead of HDRP properties
criticalMistakes.impact: Lights wouldn't change color or emit
criticalMistakes.solution: Use _BaseColor and _EmissiveColor for HDRP Lit materials

criticalMistakes.impact: Material memory leak in Play mode builds
criticalMistakes.solution: Move material cleanup outside editor-only blocks

criticalMistakes.issue: Used GetComponentsInChildren instead of explicit light names
criticalMistakes.impact: Might grab wrong objects or miss specific lights
criticalMistakes.solution: Explicitly find lights by their naming convention

bestPractices: Always check material properties match the shader being used
Material instancing must be cleaned up in OnDestroy
Use specific object names rather than generic queries
Test in Edit mode with preview functionality before Play mode
Let agents review code before committing

planned: Additional lighting effects beyond sequential strips

notes.repoStructure: Galaxy-Water-main is a separate shader project, not the main Unity project
notes.syncStrategy: Planning to create Windows Service to auto-sync Git repo changes to actual Unity project folder
notes.communicationStyle: Direct, technical, no unnecessary emojis unless requested
